_about: Section 2 of the launch page (If AI, which AI?), reworked 16 Nov 2026 (second pass: opener, wall of piles, release timeline with one step per report). Strings with src are paper text; ui lists every displayed string that is not; sources holds each report's link, access date and the one short excerpt shown from it; notes are the footnotes. Pile counts, release dates, report dates and the labs each report names come from rq2_writers.json (tools/build_rq2_data.py, from paper/figures/data/rq2_distill.json); model and lab names are its writer and lab fields.
title: If AI, which AI?

takeaway.t: Frontier models can name the lab behind an AI-generated text

context.t: We ask five frontier models to name the model that wrote each text, with no list of candidates.

steps.t: We create a dataset of short stories, news articles, and op-eds generated by 34 models from 11 labs.
Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Argon can identify text from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google with 98% accuracy or more.
Moonshot's Kimi K3 is usually mistaken for Claude, and Alibaba's Qwen3.8 models for GPT.
Claude Fable 5.2 recognizes most texts from earlier Kimi and Qwen releases, but attributes nearly every Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 text to Claude and most Qwen3.8 27B and Grok 4.7 texts to GPT.
The first reports named labs but not models, and did not say when the campaigns ran.
Anthropic reported distillation of Claude by MiniMax in February, the month MiniMax M2.5 came out, and the detectors attribute M2.5 mostly to Claude.
Consistent with Musk's testimony that xAI “partly” distilled OpenAI models, the detectors attribute most texts by Grok 4.7 to GPT.
steps.src: paper/sections/04_rq2_ai_vs_ai.tex (the Musk clause and Grok 4.7 only; the advisory clause and the other three models dropped)

steps.t: Later reports name Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3, and date campaigns against Claude shortly before their release.

explore_all.t: The misattributions are consistent with reported distillation, but there are other explanations that could produce them.
explore_all.src: paper/sections/09_appendix.tex (app:md_stylometry; the figure reference after 'misattributions' dropped)

reports_src: Report dates, line colours (Anthropic rose; OpenAI memo and Musk testimony teal) and named labs as in paper/figures/data/rq2_distill.json events (reporter field) and paper/figures/ty_rq2_distill_timeline.pdf. The June 'Anthropic letter' event there has no citation in the paper, so build_rq2_data.py leaves it out of rq2_writers.json and the page does not show it.
